Name: (CP) Ilyeana's Siamese Farm Cat
Author: IlyeanaPlus
Description:
Have you ever needed an adorable Siamese farm cat wandering around, keeping you company while you work tirelessly on your farm? 

Well I definitely did!

And now you can have one too  = >.< =

This simple mod replaces the ginger kitty (First option) with a blue-eyed baby that will crawl into your heart. And probably get in your way in the farmhouse.


***Probably not compatible with other mods that modify the farm cat.

[u]Planned Updates:[/u]
- More cats
- Skins for Adopt n' Shop

[u]I often use mods from my favourite creators in some of my screenshots! They include:[/u]
- DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour
- Gwen's Paths (Gweniaczek)
- Fruit Smoothie Recolors
- Fairy Garden Furniture Pack (Hime & Flour) 
- Greenhouse Furniture (Hime & Flour)
[i]Please check out their mods here on Nexus![/i]


Enjoy!


In memory of Ozzy, and all the other beloved meezers that are no longer with us </3
